correctness.rationale: For every even m>=2, t=nu_2(m) and i>=3 if t=1, i>=2 if t>=2, the coefficient difference is congruent to 2^E exactly on odd-square indices mod 2^(E+1), with E=3i-4 for t=1 and E=3i+2t-5 otherwise. Verified the polynomial recurrence R_(i+1)=Theta(R_i) and stable y=x-1 coefficient invariant c1 odd and c0+2c1=4 mod 8, implying v_2(Theta(Q))=3 and preserving normalized constant/derivative. The m≡2 mod4 seed starts R3 valuation1; m divisible by4 seed follows Chebyshev R2 derivatives; E=v_i+4. Because xi=A^4=1 mod8 and (xi-1)/8 reduces to odd squares modulo2, the claimed exact support follows. Independently computed 644 integer coefficients for m=2,4,6,8,12,16 at all feasible n and i=2..6 (n*2^i<=256); all assertions held. Finite check is not an infinite proof.
